text:
elaine-secops: heads up — public PoC just dropped for CVE-2026-3412 (nginx module loader). Affects our edge gateways and some dedicated gateways. can we triage priority + timeline? @michael-eng @randal-sre :rotating_light:
michael-eng: ugh. any CVSS / exploitability notes? which modules exactly? link?
elaine-secops: cvss 8.2 (high), PoC posted on GitHub: https://github.com/poc/example
elaine-secops: affected: nginx binary in our edge container image (custom module loader). exploit requires crafted request but can be triggered remotely — public exploit works against default config.
randal-sre: if PoC is public this becomes P1 for us until mitigated. recommend immediate canary on non-prod and low-traffic region, then progressive rollout.
sophia-customer-succ: flagging this to enterprise customers on dedicated gateways (a few have strict SLAs). we'll need an ETA to include in comms.
michael-eng: agree P1. quick questions: does the patch require config changes or is it a binary bump? want to know KMS/key rotation impact.
elaine-secops: it's a binary bump only — no config changes, no KMS rotation required. image tag change should be sufficient. example deploy command: `kubectl set image deploy/edge nginx=redwood/nginx:1.21.6-patch-1`
randal-sre: plan proposal:
- 0-2h: build patched image + run CI smoke
- 2-4h: canary deploy to eu-west-1 low-traffic pool
- 4-24h: monitor metrics (5xx, latency, error budget), rollback if >1% error or latency regressions
- 24-48h: full rollout global if green
fallback: route traffic to legacy gateway variant if we hit issues.
michael-eng: +1. add automatic rollback policy and healthchecks (probe failure threshold 3). we should also disable all experimental modules in canary just in case.
sophia-customer-succ: i'll prepare customer advisory draft and share once we have ETA — likely will request immediate notification for tier-1 customers.
elaine-secops: i've created internal ticket #SEC-2026-87 and assigned to @randal-sre and @michael-eng. patch-bot will create deploy run.
patch-bot: Created task SEC-2026-87, started image build, CI queued. ETA for canary start ~2h.
randal-sre: assigning oncall for the next 48h window: @randal-sre (primary), @michael-eng (secondary). paging rules unchanged.
michael-eng: will add post-deploy smoke that hits the module codepaths. also will run quick static scan on patched binary.
elaine-secops: decision: priority=P1 due to public PoC and remote exploitability. timeline = canary in ~2h, global in <=48h pending health. customer comms to be sent after canary start.
sophia-customer-succ: noted. i'll sync with legal for wording w/ mitigation steps and expected ETA.
patch-bot: Canary deploy started in eu-west-1 (canary pool: edge-canary-3). CI build id: 2026-481.
randal-sre: monitoring: no increased 5xx in first 10m, latency stable. continue rollout per plan. :thumbsup:
michael-eng: if anything flares up we roll back to `redwood/nginx:1.21.5-stable` and open incident.
elaine-secops: thanks team. we'll keep thread updated. repeating: do not mention internal mitigations in external comms — keep high-level only.
